Author: Narlei Moreira
Name: Now Playing
Description: Shows the song playing right now on Spotify or Apple Music — album cover, title, artist and a progress bar — right on your Ulanzi Deck button. Adds a Progress ring you can seek with a dial, and a live Volume key that fills up as you turn the volume up.

Actions.Name: Now Playing
Actions.Tooltip: Album cover, track title, artist and playback progress for Spotify or Apple Music.

Actions.Name: Progress
Actions.Tooltip: A progress ring for the current track. On a dial, turn to jump forward or back.

Actions.Name: Volume
Actions.Tooltip: Live macOS output volume: the key fills up as the volume rises. Click to mute, or to step it up or down.
